published_input.authors: Galyna Livshyts; Grigoris Paouris; Peter Pivovarov
published_input.title: On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures
published_input.used_scope: Every k-dimensional orthogonal marginal of a product probability density with one-dimensional factors bounded by one has density at most 2^(k/2).

premise_sources.scope: Independent original-coordinate banks; rank r>2 physical cross block; arbitrary same-side quadratic and affine terms; continuous C0 density; rank3 bound 6 times inverse cubic root of singular-value product.
Residual density cap M plus original scalar Schur pivot a!=0 gives essential bound 2 sqrt(M/|a|) without post-completion independence.

new_results.statement: For independent original banks X,Y and scalar Z, rank2 X-Y cross block B with nonzero singular-value product Delta, and hub slopes c to X and d to Y, let gamma=max(dist(c,ran B),dist(d,ran B^T)). If gamma>0, arbitrary same-side quadratic/affine terms are retained and the quadratic law has a continuous C0 density with ||p||_infinity <= 6 (Delta gamma)^(-1/3).
Combining the new base theorem with account04/B18 dependent-square smoothing gives ||p||_infinity <= 2 sqrt(6) |a|^(-1/2)(Delta gamma)^(-1/6). Continuity is not claimed through this wrapper.

target_valid_example.target_certificate: Principal block on (X1,Y1,X2,Y2) has eigenvalues {-1,-1,1,1}; Cauchy interlacing forces at least four full-matrix eigenvalues of modulus at least one.

unresolved_implication: The local rank-two packet remains unpaid when both hub slopes are aligned or nearly aligned with the corresponding cross ranges: c approximately in ran B and d approximately in ran B^T. The unrestricted QFORM conjecture and full-target continuity remain open.
next_action: Exploit doubly aligned geometry: show same-side curvature supplies a third cross direction, or reduce the aligned packet to an already-paid scalar-pivot/zero-pivot/grouped receiver without deleting coefficients or inventing independence.
